svg.title: Developer ID — a hanging identity card for Raman Kumar Tiwari
svg.desc: A lanyard-hung developer ID card with the supplied portrait, name, GitHub handle tiwariraman884, role, and location Roorkee Uttarakhand India. The card drops in, swings once with damping, then holds a small perpetual swing. Only verified identity details are shown.

g.text: This card shows only identity details supplied by the profile owner.
No stars, followers, repository counts, contribution totals or usage metrics.
